combo1.title: Masquerade V Rank-Up Chain: Gorgonic to Chaos Barian Dragon
combo1.description: Going first from Gorgonic Umbral Horror alone. Number 104: Masquerade V needs three Level 4 monsters, but Gorgonic counts as two of them. From there the line climbs Rank 4 to Rank 5 to Rank 7 without a Rank-Up-Magic Spell. Every step is an Xyz Summon that keeps its materials, and C104 Victory picks up Masquerade V's banish effect on the way. Nibiru is live once C104 Victory lands, since it is the fifth summon. The Barian's guide covers the longer Barian's Seventh Untopia version. Starting hand: Gorgonic Umbral Horror.

cards.name: Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory

steps.text: Activate effect: Gorgonic Umbral Horror in your hand. You control no monsters.
Special Summon Gorgonic Umbral Horror. While it is face-up, the only monsters you can Special Summon from the Extra Deck are Number Xyz Monsters.
Add V Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon V Umbral Horror.
Activate effect: V Umbral Horror was Normal Summoned.
Add Shining Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand.
Xyz Summon Number 104: Masquerade V. Masquerade V is a Number, so Gorgonic's restriction allows it.
Gorgonic Umbral Horror becomes material for Masquerade V. It counts as 2 of the 3 materials.
V Umbral Horror becomes the third material.
Activate effect: Shining Umbral Horror in your hand, because you Special Summoned a Masquerade Xyz Monster.
Special Summon Shining Umbral Horror and draw 1 card.
Activate effect: Number 104: Masquerade V.
Detach V Umbral Horror as the cost.
Add Barian's Seal from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: V Umbral Horror in your Graveyard. Banish it and target Masquerade V.
Special Summon Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory from your Extra Deck with Masquerade V as its material. This is treated as an Xyz Summon.
Masquerade V becomes material for C104 Victory.
Gorgonic Umbral Horror transfers along with Masquerade V.

Activate effect: C104 Victory gained Masquerade V's effect, because Masquerade V was on the field when it became material. Your opponent either banishes 4 monsters with different Attributes and 1 Spell from their Deck, or you banish the top 10 cards of their Deck.
Xyz Summon CXyz Hope Chaos Barian Dragon using only Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory. Gorgonic is material rather than a face-up monster, so its restriction does not apply.
C104 Victory becomes material for the Dragon.
Masquerade V transfers along with C104 Victory. The Dragon does not inherit Masquerade V's effect.

Gorgonic Umbral Horror transfers too, so the Dragon holds 3 cards: C104 Victory, Masquerade V and Gorgonic. That is 3000 ATK, and a Number C is attached, so your opponent can no longer add cards from their Main Deck to their hand except by drawing.
Activate effect: CXyz Hope Chaos Barian Dragon.

Detach Gorgonic Umbral Horror as the cost, then attach the top 2 cards of your opponent's Deck to the Dragon. It now has 4 materials and 4000 ATK. Keep C104 Victory attached, because the lock needs a Number C.

Set Barian's Seal. With the Dragon on the field, it negates your opponent's first Spell, Trap or monster effect next turn, then lets you attach a monster to one of your Xyz Monsters. End board: the Dragon with 4 materials, Shining Umbral Horror, a set Barian's Seal, and the card Shining drew.

combo2.title: Seventh Tachyon Reveal: Masquerade V into C104 Victory (Going Second)
combo2.description: Going second in a Number deck that already runs Seventh Tachyon. Masquerade V has the same Rank 4 LIGHT Spellcaster profile as the 2013 Masquerade, so revealing it can add V Umbral Horror, Shining Umbral Horror, or the deck's own LIGHT Level 4s such as Utopic Onomatopoeia, ZS - Ascended Sage and Astraltopia. Shining's draw gets back the card Tachyon put on top of your Deck. C104 Victory breaks one card with its Quick Effect and wins its battle. Barian's Hope then brings Gorgonic back for a second Masquerade V, which adds Barian's Seal for the following turn. Starting hand: Seventh Tachyon + Utopic Onomatopoeia.

cards.name: Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory

steps.text: Activate Seventh Tachyon and reveal Number 104: Masquerade V in your Extra Deck. It is a Rank 4 LIGHT Spellcaster numbered between 101 and 107, so you can add any Level 4 monster that is LIGHT or a Spellcaster.
Add V Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand.
Seventh Tachyon finishes resolving: place Utopic Onomatopoeia from your hand on top of your Deck.
Seventh Tachyon goes to the Graveyard. For the rest of the turn you can only Special Summon Xyz Monsters from the Extra Deck, and that is all this line uses.
Normal Summon V Umbral Horror.
Activate effect: V Umbral Horror was Normal Summoned.
Add Gorgonic Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: Gorgonic Umbral Horror in your hand. Every monster you control is an Umbral Horror monster.
Special Summon Gorgonic Umbral Horror.
Add Shining Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand.
Xyz Summon Number 104: Masquerade V.
Gorgonic Umbral Horror becomes material for Masquerade V. It counts as 2 of the 3 materials.
V Umbral Horror becomes the third material.
Activate effect: Shining Umbral Horror in your hand, because you Special Summoned a Masquerade Xyz Monster.
Special Summon Shining Umbral Horror.
Draw 1 card: the Utopic Onomatopoeia that Seventh Tachyon put back.
Activate effect: Number 104: Masquerade V.
Detach V Umbral Horror as the cost.
Add Barian's Hope from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: V Umbral Horror in your Graveyard. Banish it and target Masquerade V.
Special Summon Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory with Masquerade V as its material. This is treated as an Xyz Summon.
Masquerade V becomes material for C104 Victory.
Gorgonic Umbral Horror transfers along with Masquerade V.

Activate effect: C104 Victory gained Masquerade V's effect. Your opponent either banishes 4 monsters with different Attributes and 1 Spell from their Deck, or you banish the top 10 cards of their Deck.
Activate effect: Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory as a Quick Effect.
Detach Gorgonic Umbral Horror as the cost, then target 1 card your opponent controls and destroy it. Pick whichever card stops the attacks that follow.
Activate Barian's Hope.
Special Summon Gorgonic Umbral Horror from your Graveyard. While it is face-up its restriction applies again, but it still allows Number Xyz Monsters.
Barian's Hope goes to the Graveyard.
Xyz Summon a second Number 104: Masquerade V.
Gorgonic Umbral Horror becomes material for the second Masquerade V. It counts as 2 of the 3 materials.
Shining Umbral Horror becomes the third material.
Activate effect: the second Masquerade V. Its detach effect is once per turn for each copy, not once per name.
Detach Shining Umbral Horror as the cost.
Add Barian's Seal from your Deck to your hand.
Set Barian's Seal. You control Number C104, so it can negate your opponent's first activation on their next turn.

Battle Phase: C104 Victory attacks a monster. During damage calculation its ATK and DEF become that monster's higher stat + 100. If it destroys the monster, send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard and halve their LP. Masquerade V follows with 2700 ATK.
